elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Clause 9(c)(ii) limits “each Party’s total aggregate liability.”

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap uses the greater of amounts paid or payable under Section 3 and $1,000,000, but measures the 12-month period before “the event giving rise to the claim,” not before the claim itself.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Clause 9(c)(i) provides that “neither Party” is liable to the other for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party’s breach of confidentiality obligations is an Excluded Claim and therefore excluded from the aggregate cap.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party’s breach of data protection or security obligations is an Excluded Claim and therefore uncapped.
A Party’s indemnification obligations are expressly included in Excluded Claims.
A Party’s gross negligence is expressly included in Excluded Claims.
A Party’s wilful misconduct is expressly included in Excluded Claims.
A Party’s fraud is expressly included in Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party’s infringement of the other Party’s intellectual property rights is expressly included in Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The Company’s obligation to pay amounts due under Section 3 is not treated as damages subject to or counted against the limitation.
